coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Beekeeping is regulated by the 2009 beekeeping law and a Cabinet decree of 26 May 2025 (bee-breeding and apiary-organisation rules plus a natural-honey regulation); the decree text was not found, so any apiary passport or register duty is unverified. Bees fall under the animal identification system with group numbers: 107.6k hives in 1,410 beekeeping farms had group numbers in 2024 (24.kg, economist.kg). Honey export is the main compliance driver: 143 active honey subjects at end-2023 (60 in the EAEU register, 11 China, 9 Uzbekistan); 3 firms entered EU TRACES in Jun 2026; Q1 2026 exports 152.8 t, mostly to Uzbekistan. No Kyrgyz apiary-log software found; the free Kazakh Apislab app exists (availability in KG unknown). Kazakhstan introduced an apiary vet passport in Sep 2026, and a similar KG rule is unconfirmed. Related to K06 (vet drug log) but a different buyer.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Rural drinking-water systems belong to municipalities. Presidential decree No. 158 of 30 Apr 2026 starts a one-year pilot (from 10 May) in Ak-Suu and Aravan districts, and 8 district service providers (RPU) are planned, with kenesh delegation contracts being prepared. A programme covers 126 villages in Osh, Chui and Issyk-Kul with more than 450k people. Tariffs follow Cabinet Resolution No. 320: Gosantimonopoly reviews the calculation and the local kenesh decides. Water quality follows SanPiN 2.1.4.002-03 and the drinking-water technical regulation, with state sanitary control and an e-monitoring programme. Older data: 332 of 1,139 rural water lines failed sanitary norms, and more than 30% of rural systems had no working disinfection. Irrigation water-user associations (about 491) are a separate irrigation duty. Water Code in force 1 Jul 2025: wells over 30 m need a licence, shallower ones need permission, registration in the groundwater cadastre, a well passport, volume records and reporting. No software competitor found for rural billing or tariff or quality-control reporting (the Bishkek vodokanal app is urban only). Bottled-water stamps are noted as a side candidate.

result.competitor: No Kyrgyz software found for taxi-park licence, instruction-sheet or document-expiry tracking. Free state channel for applying: Tunduk, Mbank and Eldik apps. Yandex Taxi dominates (said to carry about 70% of drivers, 500+ partner parks) and sends driver memos through its driver app. Whether Yandex's partner-fleet tools track document expiry in Kyrgyzstan was not checked; this is the main competitive risk. Russian fleet apps (e.g. electronic trip-sheet and medical-check apps on RuStore) exist but are built for Russian rules.
result.duty: Taxi licensing law signed Feb 2025, in force since Aug 2025, fines enforced from 1 Jul 2026: 7,500 som (individuals), 23,000 som (legal entities). The licence is annual. Documents: certificate of no criminal record, contract with a taxi park (or employment contract, power of attorney or lease), OSAGO, passenger carrier liability insurance, tax registration, technical and medical inspection. Inspectors may ask for the instruction sheet. Cabinet Resolution No.5 (3 Sep 2026, in force 10 days after publication) adds: a road-safety briefing every quarter recorded on a sheet; ride-hailing apps must send driver status to the authority and photo-check passenger insurance; right-hand-drive cars banned; a separate licence for intercity trips over 60 km. The same resolution drops some licence documents, but the articles don't say which. Not confirmed: who runs the briefing, whether the sheet is paper only, and whether minibus operators have a parallel duty.
result.market: MVD data (Apr 2026): about 15,000 licences issued to sole traders and 410 to legal entities, with 635 applications pending. Yandex says there are 500+ partner taxi parks in 13 cities. An unofficial claim puts all taxi drivers at over 300,000. No official register count of taxi parks was found.
result.reason: The duty is real and in force. Since 1 Jul 2026 you need a taxi licence: it lasts one year and costs 500 som a year for individuals or 1,000 som for legal entities, and fines are 7,500 or 23,000 som. Inspectors can ask for the "лист инструктажа" (instruction sheet). Resolution No.5 of 3 Sep 2026 requires a safety briefing every quarter, logged on a sheet. I found no local tool that tracks the instruction sheet or document expiry. But the licence application itself is free in the Tunduk, Mbank and Eldik apps. Yandex's dominance (500+ partner parks) means its own fleet tools may cover document tracking (not checked). The market is small: about 15k sole-trader licences, 410 legal-entity licences and around 500 parks. Owner-drivers are unlikely to pay much, and the rules keep changing.
